title: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 2.0.4 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Restriction of XML External…
description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules versions 2.0.4 through 10.0.3 have an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in their XML parsing component. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially expose sensitive information. The vulnerability does not affect integrity or availability but can lead to confidentiality breaches.
